versos.hebraico: וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי־הָעָ֖ם בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּשְׁאָ֣ר הָ֠עָם הִפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת לְהָבִ֣יא׀ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־הָעֲשָׂרָ֗ה לָשֶׁ֨בֶת֙ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עִ֣יר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְתֵ֥שַׁע הַיָּד֖וֹת בֶּעָרִֽים׃

controles.web: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
controles.kjv: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
controles.livre: E os líderes do povo habitaram em Jerusalém; porém os demais do povo lançaram sortes para trazerem um de dez para habitar na santa cidade de Jerusalém, e as nove partes nas outras cidades.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְבָרֲכ֖וּ הָעָ֑ם לְכֹל֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַמִּֽתְנַדְּבִ֔ים לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

controles.web: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E o povo abençoou a todos os homens que voluntariamente se ofereceram para habitarem em Jerusalém.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הַמְּדִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשְׁב֖וּ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּבְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ אִ֤ישׁ בַּאֲחֻזָּתוֹ֙ בְּעָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם וְהַנְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃

controles.web: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah everyone lived in his possession in their cities: Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
controles.kjv: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
controles.livre: E estes são os chefes da província que habitaram em Jerusalém (porém os israelitas, os sacerdotes e os levitas, os servos do templo, e os filhos dos servos de Salomão, nas cidades de Judá, habitaram cada um em sua possessão, em suas cidades).

versos.hebraico: וּבִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יָֽשְׁב֔וּ מִבְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּמִבְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן מִבְּנֵ֣י יְ֠הוּדָה עֲתָיָ֨ה בֶן־עֻזִּיָּ֜ה בֶּן־זְכַרְיָ֧ה בֶן־אֲמַרְיָ֛ה בֶּן־שְׁפַטְיָ֥ה בֶן־מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל מִבְּנֵי־פָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: In Jerusalem lived certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
controles.kjv: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
controles.livre: Habitaram, pois, em Jerusalém , alguns dos filhos de Judá, e dos filhos de Benjamim. Dos filhos de Judá: Ataías, filho de Uzias, filho de Zacarias, filho de Amarias, filho de Sefatias, filho de Maalaleel, dos filhos de Perez;

versos.hebraico: וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֣ה בֶן־בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־כָּל־חֹ֠זֶה בֶּן־חֲזָיָ֨ה בֶן־עֲדָיָ֧ה בֶן־יוֹיָרִ֛יב בֶּן־זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־הַשִּׁלֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
controles.kjv: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col–hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
controles.livre: E Maaseias filho de Baruque, filho de Col-Hozé, filho de Hazaías, filho de Adaías, filho de Joiaribe, filho de Zacarias, filho de Siloni.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־בְּנֵי־פֶ֕רֶץ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֛וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁי־חָֽיִל׃ס

controles.web: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.
controles.kjv: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
controles.livre: Todos os filhos de Perez que habitaram em Jerusalém foram quatrocentos setenta e oito homens valentes.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן סַלֻּ֡א בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֡ם בֶּן־יוֹעֵ֡ד בֶּן־פְּדָיָה֩ בֶן־ק֨וֹלָיָ֧ה בֶן־מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה בֶּן־אִֽיתִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־יְשַֽׁעְיָֽה׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
controles.kjv: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
controles.livre: E estes são os filhos de Benjamim: Salu filho de Mesulão, filho de Joede, filho de Pedaías, filho de Colaías, filho de Maaseias, filho de Itiel, filho de Jesaías.

versos.hebraico: וְאַחֲרָ֖יו גַּבַּ֣י סַלָּ֑י תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: After him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.
controles.kjv: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
controles.livre: E após ele, Gabai, Salai, novecentos e vinte e oito.

versos.hebraico: וְיוֹאֵ֥ל בֶּן־זִכְרִ֖י פָּקִ֣יד עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וִיהוּדָ֧ה בֶן־הַסְּנוּאָ֛ה עַל־הָעִ֖יר מִשְׁנֶֽה׃פ

controles.web: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
controles.kjv: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
controles.livre: E Joel, filho de Zicri, era o supervisor deles; e Judá filho de Senua, o segundo sobre a cidade.

versos.hebraico: מִן־הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַֽעְיָ֥ה בֶן־יוֹיָרִ֖יב יָכִֽין׃

controles.web: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
controles.kjv: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
controles.livre: Dos sacerdotes: Jedaías filho de Joiaribe, Jaquim,

versos.hebraico: שְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן־חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן־צָד֗וֹק בֶּן־מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן־אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,
controles.kjv: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
controles.livre: Seraías filho de Hilquias, filho de Mesulão, filho de Zadoque, filho de Meraiote, filho de Aitube, governador da casa de Deus,

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם עֹשֵׂ֤י הַמְּלָאכָה֙ לַבַּ֔יִת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּשְׁנָ֑יִם וַ֠עֲדָיָה בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֤ם בֶּן־פְּלַלְיָה֙ בֶּן־אַמְצִ֣י בֶן־זְכַרְיָ֔ה בֶּן־פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּֽה׃

controles.web: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
controles.kjv: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,
controles.livre: E seus irmãos, que faziam a obra da casa, oitocentos vinte e dois; e Adaías filho de Jeroão, filho de Pelalias, filho de Anzi, filho de Zacarias, filho de Pasur, filho de Malquias,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶחָיו֙ רָאשִׁ֣ים לְאָב֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וּשְׁנָ֑יִם וַעֲמַשְׁסַ֧י בֶּן־עֲזַרְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־אַחְזַ֥י בֶּן־מְשִׁלֵּמ֖וֹת בֶּן־אִמֵּֽר׃

controles.web: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
controles.kjv: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
controles.livre: E seus irmãos, chefes de famílias, duzentos e quarenta e dois; e Amassai filho de Azareel, filho de Azai, filho de Mesilemote, filho de Imer,

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֑ה וּפָקִ֣יד עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם זַבְדִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־הַגְּדוֹלִֽים׃ס

controles.web: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
controles.kjv: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.
controles.livre: E seus irmãos, homens valentes, cento e vinte e oito; e o supervisor sobre eles era Zabdiel, filho de Gedolim.

versos.hebraico: וּמִֽן־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַעְיָ֧ה בֶן־חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן־עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה בֶּן־בּוּנִּֽי׃

controles.web: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
controles.kjv: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
controles.livre: E dos Levitas: Semaías filho de Hassube, filho de Azricão, filho de Hasabias, filho de Buni;

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁבְּתַ֨י וְיוֹזָבָ֜ד עַל־הַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַחִֽיצֹנָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מֵרָאשֵׁ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;
controles.kjv: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
controles.livre: Sabetai e Jozabade, dos chefes dos Levitas, supervisores da obra de fora da casa de Deus;

versos.hebraico: וּמַתַּנְיָ֣ה בֶן־מִ֠יכָה בֶּן־זַבְדִּ֨י בֶן־אָסָ֜ף רֹ֗אשׁ הַתְּחִלָּה֙ יְהוֹדֶ֣ה לַתְּפִלָּ֔ה וּבַקְבֻּקְיָ֖ה מִשְׁנֶ֣ה מֵאֶחָ֑יו וְעַבְדָּא֙ בֶּן־שַׁמּ֔וּעַ בֶּן־גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן־ידיתון׃

controles.web: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
controles.kjv: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
controles.livre: E Matanias filho de Mica, filho de Zabdi, filho de Asafe, o chefe, o que começava a ação de graças na oração; e Baquebuquias o segundo de entre seus irmãos; e Abda filho de Samua, filho de Galal, filho de Jedutum.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּעִ֣יר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃פ

controles.web: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
controles.kjv: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
controles.livre: Todos os levitas na santa cidade foram duzentos e oitenta e quatro.

versos.hebraico: וְהַשּֽׁוֹעֲרִים֙ עַקּ֣וּב טַלְמ֔וֹן וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַשֹּׁמְרִ֣ים בַּשְּׁעָרִ֑ים מֵאָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.
controles.kjv: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.
controles.livre: E os porteiros, Acube, Talmom, com seus irmãos, os guardas das portas: cento e setenta e dois.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁאָ֨ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּכָל־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.
controles.kjv: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
controles.livre: E o demais dos israelitas, dos sacerdotes, dos levitas, estevem em todas as cidades de Judá, cada um em sua propriedade.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּעֹ֑פֶל וְצִיחָ֥א וְגִשְׁפָּ֖א עַל־הַנְּתִינִֽים׃פ

controles.web: But the Nethinim lived in Ophel: and Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.
controles.kjv: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
controles.livre: E os servos do templo habitavam em Ofel; e Zia e Gispa governavam sobre os servos do templo.

versos.hebraico: וּפְקִ֤יד הַלְוִיִּם֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עֻזִּ֤י בֶן־בָּנִי֙ בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־מִיכָ֑א מִבְּנֵ֤י אָסָף֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים לְנֶ֖גֶד מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the business of God’s house.
controles.kjv: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
controles.livre: E o supervisor dos levitas em Jerusalém foi Uzi, filho de Bani, filho de Hasabias, filho de Matanias, filho de Mica; dos filhos de Asafe estavam os cantores diante da obra da casa de Deus.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־מִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲמָנָ֥ה עַל־הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים דְּבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.
controles.kjv: For it was the king’s commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
controles.livre: Porque tinha mandamento do rei acerca deles, e determinação acerca dos cantores para cada dia.

versos.hebraico: וּפְתַֽחְיָ֨ה בֶּן־מְשֵֽׁיזַבְאֵ֜ל מִבְּנֵי־זֶ֤רַח בֶּן־יְהוּדָה֙ לְיַ֣ד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְכָל־דָּבָ֖ר לָעָֽם׃

controles.web: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
controles.kjv: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
controles.livre: E Petaías filho de Mesezabel, dos filhos de Zerá, filho de Judá, estava à mão do rei em todo negócio do povo.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־הַחֲצֵרִ֖ים בִּשְׂדֹתָ֑ם מִבְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ בְּקִרְיַ֤ת הָֽאַרְבַּע֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וּבְדִיבֹן֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וּבִֽיקַּבְצְאֵ֖ל וַחֲצֵרֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: As for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, and in Dibon and its towns, and in Jekabzeel and its villages,
controles.kjv: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath–arba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,
controles.livre: E quanto às aldeias em suas terras, alguns dos filhos de Judá habitaram em Quiriate-Arba, nas suas aldeias circunvizinhas, em Dibom e suas aldeias circunvizinhas, e em Jecabzeel e suas aldeias;

versos.hebraico: וּבְיֵשׁ֥וּעַ וּבְמוֹלָדָ֖ה וּבְבֵ֥ית פָּֽלֶט׃

controles.web: and in Jeshua, and in Moladah, and Beth Pelet,
controles.kjv: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth–phelet,
controles.livre: E em Jesua, Molada, Bete-Pelete;

versos.hebraico: וּבַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבִבְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: and in Hazar Shual, and in Beersheba and its towns,
controles.kjv: And at Hazar–shual, and at Beer–sheba, and in the villages thereof,
controles.livre: Hazar-Sual, Berseba, e em suas aldeias circunvizinhas;

versos.hebraico: וּבְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּבִמְכֹנָ֖ה וּבִבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: and in Ziklag, and in Meconah and in its towns,
controles.kjv: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
controles.livre: E em Ziclague, e em Meconá, e em suas aldeias circunvizinhas;

versos.hebraico: וּבְעֵ֥ין רִמּ֛וֹן וּבְצָרְעָ֖ה וּבְיַרְמֽוּת׃

controles.web: and in En Rimmon, and in Zorah, and in Jarmuth,
controles.kjv: And at En–rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
controles.livre: E em En-Rimom, Zorá Jarmute;

versos.hebraico: זָנֹ֤חַ עֲדֻלָּם֙ וְחַצְרֵיהֶ֔ם לָכִישׁ֙ וּשְׂדֹתֶ֔יהָ עֲזֵקָ֖ה וּבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ מִבְּאֵֽר־שֶׁ֖בַע עַד־גֵּֽיא־הִנֹּֽם׃

controles.web: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.
controles.kjv: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer–sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
controles.livre: Zanoa, Adulão, e em suas aldeias; em Laquis e suas terras; Azeca e suas aldeias circunvizinhas. E habitaram desde Berseba até o vale de Hinom.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן מִגָּ֑בַע מִכְמָ֣שׂ וְעַיָּ֔ה וּבֵֽית־אֵ֖ל וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,
controles.kjv: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Beth–el, and in their villages,
controles.livre: E os filhos de Benjamim desde Geba habitaram em Micmás, Aia, e Betel e suas aldeias circunvizinhas;

versos.hebraico: עֲנָת֥וֹת נֹ֖ב עֲנָֽנְיָֽה׃

controles.web: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
controles.kjv: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
controles.livre: Em Anatote, Nobe, Ananias;

versos.hebraico: חָצ֥וֹר׀ רָמָ֖ה גִּתָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
controles.kjv: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
controles.livre: Hazor, Ramá, Gitaim;

versos.hebraico: חָדִ֥יד צְבֹעִ֖ים נְבַלָּֽט׃

controles.web: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
controles.kjv: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
controles.livre: Hadide, Zeboim, Nebalate;

versos.hebraico: לֹ֥ד וְאוֹנ֖וֹ גֵּ֥י הַחֲרָשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
controles.kjv: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
controles.livre: Lode, e Ono, no vale dos artífices.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מַחְלְק֥וֹת יְהוּדָ֖ה לְבִנְיָמִֽין׃פ

controles.web: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.
controles.kjv: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.
controles.livre: E alguns dos Levitas, nos repartições de Judá e de Benjamim.
